# site.yaml reference

`site.yaml` sits at the top of the site directory. Unknown keys are errors at every level. A
commented starting point is `site.sample/site.yaml.sample`; `make init-site` copies it, together
with `site.schema.json` that gives editors with YAML language support completion and checks.

| Key | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | string | yes | Site title, shown in the header and in page titles. |
| `baseUrl` | string | yes | Absolute http(s) origin the site is served from, without a path. Used for canonical URLs, the sitemap and `robots.txt`. |
| `favicon` | string | no | Site icon: a .svg, .png or .ico file below the site directory. |
| `appleTouchIcon` | string | no | Apple touch icon: a .png file below the site directory (180x180 recommended). |
| `copyright` | mapping | yes | Copyright line in the footer; the years run from the earliest year of a published item to the current year. |
| `copyright.holder` | string | yes | Name shown in the copyright line. |
| `copyright.rights` | string | yes | Rights statement after the holder, e.g. "All rights reserved." |
| `sections` | mapping | yes | Sections of the site. Each key is a directory below the site directory and the first URL segment of its items; it must be a clean slug. |
| `sections.<key>.label` | string | yes | Name of the section in the menu, and heading of its page unless the section's index.md has a title. |
| `sections.<key>.noun` | [string, string] | yes | Singular and plural name of one item, e.g. [post, posts]; used in texts such as "All posts" and "No posts yet". |
| `sections.<key>.taxonomies` | list of `categories` \| `tags` | yes | Taxonomies the section uses: categories and/or tags. Each gets a term index and a page per term. The first declared one fills the menu when `menu` is `taxonomy`. |
| `sections.<key>.menu` | `taxonomy` \| `items` \| `none` | yes | What the menu group of the section lists besides its "All ..." link: `taxonomy` (the terms of the first declared taxonomy), `items` (the items by title) or `none` (a plain link, no group). |
| `sections.<key>.layout` | `"stream"` \| `"cards"` \| `"list"` | yes | How the section page shows its items: `stream` (full articles, further ones loaded while scrolling), `cards` (a grid of cards) or `list` (titles and dates). |
| `sections.<key>.stream` | mapping | no | Progressive loading of a `stream` section. Required for the `stream` layout, forbidden for the others. |
| `sections.<key>.stream.initial` | integer ≥ 0 | yes | Items rendered on the section page at first load. |
| `sections.<key>.stream.batch` | integer ≥ 1 | yes | Items revealed per further step while scrolling. |
| `menu` | list of string | yes | Menu entries after the implicit Home: names of sections or of top-level pages, in order. |
| `home` | list of mapping | yes | Blocks of the home page, in order. Each has either `latest` or `featured`, plus `count`. |
| `home[].latest` | string | no | Key of the section whose newest items are shown (by published date). |
| `home[].count` | integer ≥ 0 | yes | Number of items shown. |
| `home[].featured` | string | no | Key of the section whose items with `featured: true` are shown, newest first. |

## Rules beyond the table

- A section key is a clean slug: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens. It must contain a
  letter and must not be one of `attributions`, `assets`.
- `menu: taxonomy` needs at least one entry in `taxonomies`.
- A `latest` or `featured` block names a declared section.
- Every `menu` entry is a declared section or a top-level page of the site directory; none repeats.
- `favicon` and `appleTouchIcon` are relative paths with `/` separators to files below the site
  directory, without `..` segments and without a segment starting with `_`.
- `baseUrl` is an origin only: scheme, host and optional port, no path and no trailing slash.
